review_note: Pinned derham.tex line 172 independently validated against proof-masked original statement: For a qcqs morphism p, derived direct image of a complex of quasi-coherent modules has quasi-coherent cohomology; the relative de Rham complex has quasi-coherent terms. The qc and qs assumptions are preserved, as is derived rather than underived pushforward.
statement: Let $p:X\to S$ be a quasi-compact, quasi-separated morphism of schemes. Write $\Omega^\bullet_{X/S}=(\mathcal O_X\xrightarrow{d}\Omega^1_{X/S}\xrightarrow{d}\Omega^2_{X/S}\to\cdots)$ for the relative de Rham complex, where $\Omega^i_{X/S}=\bigwedge^i_{\mathcal O_X}\Omega^1_{X/S}$. Then the derived direct image $Rp_*\Omega^\bullet_{X/S}$ belongs to $D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_S)$: every cohomology sheaf $\mathcal H^n(Rp_*\Omega^\bullet_{X/S})$ is quasi-coherent on $S$.
hypotheses: $p:X\to S$ is a quasi-compact, quasi-separated morphism of schemes.
conclusions: For all $n\in\mathbb Z$, $\mathcal H^n(Rp_*\Omega^\bullet_{X/S})$ is quasi-coherent.
original_source_statement_tex:
\label{lemma-quasi-coherence-relative}
Let $p : X \to S$ be a morphism of schemes. If $p$ is quasi-compact
and quasi-separated, then $Rp_*\Omega^\bullet_{X/S}$ is an object
of $D_\QCoh(\mathcal{O}_S)$.

review_note: Pinned derham.tex line 190 independently validated against proof-masked original statement: For a proper map over locally Noetherian base, the relative de Rham complex is bounded with coherent differential sheaves and its derived pushforward has coherent cohomology by proper mapping theorem. All source finiteness assumptions are retained.
statement: Let $p:X\to S$ be a proper morphism of schemes, and assume $S$ is locally Noetherian. Let $\Omega^\bullet_{X/S}$ denote the relative de Rham complex of $\mathcal O_X$-modules, with $\Omega^a_{X/S}=\bigwedge^a_{\mathcal O_X}\Omega^1_{X/S}$ placed in cohomological degree $a$. Then the derived direct image $Rp_*\Omega^\bullet_{X/S}$ is an object of $D_{\mathrm{Coh}}(\mathcal O_S)$: its cohomology sheaves $\mathcal H^n(Rp_*\Omega^\bullet_{X/S})$ are coherent $\mathcal O_S$-modules for all integers $n$.
hypotheses: $p:X\to S$ is proper and $S$ is locally Noetherian.
conclusions: Every cohomology sheaf of $Rp_*\Omega^\bullet_{X/S}$ is coherent on $S$.
original_source_statement_tex:
\label{lemma-coherence-relative}
Let $p : X \to S$ be a proper morphism of schemes with $S$ locally
Noetherian. Then $Rp_*\Omega^\bullet_{X/S}$ is an object
of $D_{\textit{Coh}}(\mathcal{O}_S)$.

review_note: Pinned derham.tex line 215 independently validated against proof-masked original statement: For a proper smooth morphism, relative differential bundles Ω^p and the de Rham complex are perfect and their derived pushforwards remain perfect and satisfy arbitrary derived base change; both families of objects and the universal base-change scope are preserved.
statement:
Let $f:X\to S$ be a proper, smooth morphism of schemes. For $p\geq 0$ put $\Omega^p_{X/S}=\bigwedge^p_{\mathcal O_X}\Omega^1_{X/S}$, and let $\Omega^\bullet_{X/S}$ be the relative de Rham complex. Each $Rf_*\Omega^p_{X/S}$ and the derived direct image $Rf_*\Omega^\bullet_{X/S}$ are perfect objects of $D(\mathcal O_S)$.

More precisely, for every morphism $g:S'\to S$ of schemes, let $X'=X\times_S S'$, $g':X'\to X$, and $f':X'\to S'$ be the induced maps. For each $p\geq0$ the canonical derived base-change map
$$Lg^*(Rf_*\Omega^p_{X/S})\longrightarrow Rf'_*\Omega^p_{X'/S'}$$
is an isomorphism in $D(\mathcal O_{S'})$, and so is the analogous map
$$Lg^*(Rf_*\Omega^\bullet_{X/S})\longrightarrow Rf'_*\Omega^\bullet_{X'/S'}.$$
hypotheses: $f:X\to S$ is proper and smooth; for base change, $S'\to S$ is arbitrary and $X'=X\times_S S'$.
conclusions: The derived pushforwards of every $\Omega^p_{X/S}$ and of the full relative de Rham complex are perfect and satisfy derived base change for every $S'\to S$.
original_source_statement_tex:
\label{lemma-proper-smooth-de-Rham}
Let $f : X \to S$ be a proper smooth morphism of schemes. Then
$Rf_*\Omega^p_{X/S}$, $p \geq 0$ and $Rf_*\Omega^\bullet_{X/S}$ are
perfect objects of $D(\mathcal{O}_S)$ whose formation commutes
with arbitrary change of base.
